page.layout: One printed page, two columns of index entries, parallel. Left column: A and entries beginning with A. Right column: continuation of the left column at its top, then B, C and their entries. Running head at the top above the columns. Signature at the foot right, below the right column.

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Doubtful readings: "matrete,in" (line 1 of the left column) may be a misprint for another word; "Armmiani" and "Armatarum" are read from a faint scan; "Iuris.execratio" shows a broken character between Iuris and execratio; "Aragonici" is read as the start of the column break line. The Greek "πυρρηνία" is copied as it appears on the scan and is not certain. "Bonifacij... &c." ends with an abbreviation as printed. Left-column line "Alllegationis" has three l's as printed. The running head is taken verbatim from the top of the page. The number under the signature "¶. j." is the gathering mark, not a page number.
